home.heroText: Hi, I'm Archimede and I'll be your guide! Pick a module and let's build web pages together, one step at a time.

inventory.tagsHelp: Click a tag to add it to your code, or drag it in blocks mode. In a CSS file, a tag becomes a rule.
inventory.propertiesHelp: Click a property to add it to your CSS, or drag it into a rule in blocks mode.
inventory.imagesHelp: Click an image to add it to your code, or import your own.
inventory.importTitle: Add an image from your computer
inventory.removeConfirm: Remove "{{name}}"? Your pages that use it won't show it anymore.
inventory.tooBig: "{{name}}" is too big: GIF and SVG images can be 2 MB at most.
inventory.unreadable: "{{name}}" couldn't be read: try another format (PNG or JPG).
inventory.importFailed: "{{name}}" couldn't be imported: this browser may be out of space.

tags.div: Defines a section in a document
tags.i: Text in an alternate voice or mood
tags.details: Defines additional details that the user can view or hide
tags.summary: Defines a visible heading for a <details> element
tags.form: Represents a document section containing interactive controls for submitting information
tags.label: Represents a caption for an item in a user interface

properties.font-style: The font style of the text
properties.display: How the element is laid out

code.resetConfirm: Start this exercise again? Your code will be erased in every file.
code.readOnlyBanner: this file is given for the exercise, you don't need to change it.

repair.title: Your code has a little problem
repair.text: The browser can still show it, but it had to guess what you meant:
repair.undo: You can always undo the browser's fix with Ctrl + Z.

result.resize: Drag to resize, double-click to reset

blocks.textTitle: Free text, to mix with tags like <b>
blocks.rawTitle: Blocks can't show this yet: edit it as code
blocks.dropSelector: Drop a selector here to create a rule
blocks.propertiesLabel: Properties: drop them into a rule
blocks.noSelectors: Add tags to your HTML first

css.noProperty: This declaration has no property name.
css.badValue: "{{value}}" is not a valid value for "{{property}}".
css.missingColon: "{{text}}" (line {{line}}) is missing a ":" between the property and its value.
css.missingSemicolon: Missing ";" at the end of line {{line}}.
css.valueWithoutProperty: The value "{{value}}" (line {{line}}) has no property name before its ":".
css.blockNotClosed: The block starting line {{line}} is never closed: add a "}".
css.commentNotClosed: The comment starting line {{line}} is never closed: add "*/".
css.strayBrace: "}" on line {{line}} closes a rule that was never opened.
css.outsideRule: "{{text}}" (line {{line}}) is not inside a rule: it needs a selector and { }.
css.ruleNotClosed: The rule "{{selector}}" (line {{line}}) is never closed: add a "}".

html.missingBracket: The tag <{{name}}> on line {{line}} is missing its closing ">".
html.voidClosed: <{{name}}> never needs a closing tag: remove </{{name}}> on line {{line}}.
html.neverOpened: </{{name}}> on line {{line}} closes a tag that was never opened.
html.rearranged: The browser had to rearrange your code around line {{line}}. Check that every tag is in the right place.

tour.welcomeText: Would you like a quick tour to learn how the game works?
tour.clients: Those are the requests from your clients. They will tell you what they want!
tour.mission: This tab contains information about the level and hints on how to solve it
tour.images: In this tab you can add images to your code. There are already some images but you can import new ones
tour.tags: You can click here to have a longer list of different tags, along with more details of what they do
tour.properties: You can click here to have a longer list of different properties, along with some details of what they do
tour.objectives: You can click here to see the objectives of the current level in an explicit way
tour.hints: If you need some help, don't hesitate to check the hints here!
tour.mode: You can switch between two modes: code (the raw code, you can edit everything) and blocks (you use premade blocks to edit the page)
tour.preview: This is the result of the code. It's updated automatically unless you deactivate the live option
tour.live: Whether the preview should be automatically updated when the code is modified
tour.run: Click here to update the preview if you deactivated the Live option
tour.example: An example of what you could do
tour.fun: Don't hesitate to ask for help if you're stuck. I hope you will have fun doing this module!
tour.darkmode: You can toggle between dark mode and light mode with this button
tour.guide: You can redo the tutorial with this button!
